source_text: Initial modeling by UNAIDS, WHO, and partners in 2011 projected that achieving 80% coverage among males aged 15-49 could avert 3.4 million HIV infections and save $2 billion in treatment costs by 2025, guiding national strategies with targets like 20 million VMMCs by 2015. [73]
